name: Instagram
description: Replies and monitoring for your Instagram account.
author: NextBrowser Team

watchlist.title: Profiles to answer
watchlist.blurb: Profiles whose comments NextBrowser answers in your browser profile — usually your own account. Every pass finds comments nobody from the account has answered yet, shows you each draft, and posts only the replies you approve.
watchlist.subscribeTask: Add @{handle} to the Instagram reply list: open https://www.instagram.com/{handle}/ in the browser profile, confirm the profile exists and that the signed-in account can comment there, and record @{handle} in the state file with its newest post as the baseline. Reply to nothing and like nothing in this run.
watchlist.checkTask: Run one reply pass on Instagram in the browser over these profiles: {handles}. Only these profiles are on the list right now. For each, open its three newest posts and find comments newer than the recorded baseline that nobody from the signed-in account has answered. Read each comment and its thread and write a reply that answers that specific comment - never a canned line. Show me every draft before anything goes out, then post only the ones I approve with the comment's own Reply button, a few per profile, and stop at the first failure. Update the state file.
